A square image overlay at the bottom shows a low-angle illustration of the character with an exaggerated chin. (2) The scene shifts to a slightly different angle in an indoor room with a pink chair and a monitor in the background. The person tilts their head far back, exposing their neck, and uses a makeup brush from a small palette to apply dark contour lines horizontally across their throat. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the neck area as the person uses a dark brown makeup pencil to draw a sharp, defined line under the jawbone to mimic a double-chin effect. Their eyes are looking upward, and their hands are steady while applying the pigment. (4) The person completes the makeup and looks up at the camera with an exaggerated wide-eyed expression. A yellow laughing emoji with tears appears in the upper right corner. (5) The person returns to a front-facing position, holding the plushie again, and mimics the upward-tilted pose from the illustration overlay, showing off the completed neck makeup that creates a visual illusion of the meme's perspective.
